title: Free or cheap Wii Remote hacks
speaker: Johnny Lee

sentences.en: So, as researchers, something that we often do is use immense resources to achieve certain capabilities, or achieve certain goals.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为研究人员，我们经常做的事情就是利用巨大的资源来实现某些能力，或者实现某些目标。

sentences.en: And this is essential to the progress of science, or exploration of what is possible.
sentences.zh: 这对于科学进步或探索可能性至关重要。

sentences.en: But it creates this unfortunate situation where a tiny, tiny fraction of the world can actually participate in this exploration or can benefit from that technology.
sentences.zh: 但它造成了这种不幸的情况，世界上只有一小部分人实际上可以参与这项探索或可以从该技术中受益。

sentences.en: Something that motivates me, and gets me really excited about my research, is when I see simple opportunities to drastically change that distribution and make the technology accessible to a much wider percentage of the population.
sentences.zh: 当我看到一些简单的机会可以彻底改变这种分布并使更广泛的人口能够使用该技术时，激励我并使我对我的研究感到非常兴奋的事情。

sentences.en: I'm going to show you two videos that have gotten a lot of attention that I think embody this philosophy.
sentences.zh: 我将向您展示两个受到广泛关注的视频，我认为它们体现了这一理念。

sentences.en: And they actually use the Nintendo Wii Remote.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上使用任天堂 Wii 遥控器。

sentences.en: For those of you who aren't familiar with this device, it's a $40 video game controller.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不熟悉该设备的人来说，它是一个售价 40 美元的视频游戏控制器。

sentences.en: And it's mostly advertised for its motion-sensing capabilities: so you can swing a tennis racket, or hit a baseball bat.
sentences.zh: 它主要宣传其运动感应功能：这样你就可以挥动网球拍，或击打棒球棒。

sentences.en: But what actually interests me a lot more is the fact that in the tip of each controller is a relatively high-performing infrared camera.
sentences.zh: 但真正让我更感兴趣的是，每个控制器的尖端都有一个相对高性能的红外摄像头。

sentences.en: And I'm going to show you two demos of why this is useful.
sentences.zh: 我将向您展示两个演示，说明为什么这很有用。

sentences.en: So here, I have my computer set up with the projector, and I have a Wii Remote sitting on top of it.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我在电脑上安装了投影仪，并在上面放置了一个 Wii 遥控器。

sentences.en: And, for example, if you're in a school that doesn't have a lot money, probably a lot of schools, or if you're in an office environment, and you want an interactive whiteboard, normally these cost about two to three thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 而且，例如，如果您在一所没有很多钱的学校，可能有很多学校，或者如果您在办公环境中，并且您想要一个交互式白板，通常这些花费大约是两到三千美元。

sentences.en: So I'm going to show you how to create one with a Wii Remote.
sentences.zh: 所以我将向您展示如何使用 Wii 遥控器创建一个。

sentences.en: Now, this requires another piece of hardware, which is this infrared pen.
sentences.zh: 现在，这需要另一个硬件，那就是红外笔。

sentences.en: You can probably make this yourself for about five dollars with a quick trip to the Radio Shack.
sentences.zh: 您可以花大约五美元自己制作这个，只需快速前往无线电小屋即可。

sentences.en: It's got a battery, a button and an infrared LED -- you guys can't see it -- but it turns on whenever I push the button.
sentences.zh: 它有一个电池、一个按钮和一个红外 LED——你们看不到它——但只要我按下按钮，它就会亮起。

sentences.en: Now, what this means is that if I run this piece of software, the camera sees the infrared dot, and I can register the location of the camera pixels
sentences.zh: 现在，这意味着如果我运行这个软件，相机会看到红外点，我可以注册相机像素的位置

sentences.en: to the projector pixels. And now this is like an interactive whiteboard surface.
sentences.zh: 到投影仪像素。现在这就像一个交互式白板表面。

sentences.en: (Applause) So for about $50 of hardware, you can have your own whiteboard.
sentences.zh: （掌声）因此，只需大约 50 美元的硬件，您就可以拥有自己的白板。

sentences.en: This is Adobe Photoshop. (Applause) Thank you.
sentences.zh: 这是 Adob​​e Photoshop。 （鼓掌）谢谢。

sentences.en: (Laughter) The software for this I've actually put on my website and have let people download it for free.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我实际上已经将这个软件放在我的网站上并让人们免费下载。

sentences.en: In the three months this project has been public, it's been downloaded over half a million times.
sentences.zh: 在该项目公开的三个月内，下载量已超过 50 万次。

sentences.en: So teachers and students all around the world are already using this.
sentences.zh: 所以世界各地的老师和学生已经在使用它。

sentences.en: (Applause) Although it does do it for 50 dollars, there are some limitations of this approach.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）虽然50美元确实可以做到，但是这种方法有一些局限性。

sentences.en: You get about 80 percent of the way there, for one percent of the cost.
sentences.zh: 只需花费 1% 的费用，即可完成大约 80% 的行程。

sentences.en: Another nice thing is that a camera can see multiple dots, so this is actually a multi-touch, interactive whiteboard system as well.
sentences.zh: 另一个好处是相机可以看到多个点，所以这实际上也是一个多点触控、交互式白板系统。

sentences.en: (Applause) For the second demo, I have this Wii Remote that's actually next to the TV.
sentences.zh: （掌声）对于第二个演示，我有一个 Wii 遥控器，它实际上位于电视旁边。

sentences.en: So it's pointing away from the display, rather than pointing at the display.
sentences.zh: 因此它指向远离显示屏的方向，而不是指向显示屏。

sentences.en: And why this is interesting is that if you put on, say, a pair of safety glasses, that have two infrared dots in them, they are going to give the computer an approximation of your head location.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣的原因在于，如果您戴上一副安全眼镜，其中有两个红外点，它们将为计算机提供您头部位置的近似值。

sentences.en: And why this is interesting is I have this sort of application running on the computer monitor, which has a 3D room, with some targets floating in it.
sentences.zh: 为什么这很有趣，因为我在计算机显示器上运行了这种应用程序，它有一个 3D 房间，其中漂浮着一些目标。

sentences.en: And you can see that it looks like a 3D room.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到它看起来像一个 3D 房间。

sentences.en: kind of like a video game, it sort of looks 3D, but for the most part, the image looks pretty flat, and bound to the surface of the screen.
sentences.zh: 有点像视频游戏，它看起来有点 3D，但在大多数情况下，图像看起来非常平坦，并且绑定到屏幕表面。

sentences.en: But if we turn on head tracking -- the computer can change the image that's on the screen and make it respond to the head movements.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们打开头部跟踪，计算机就可以改变屏幕上的图像并使其对头部运动做出反应。

sentences.en: So let's switch back to that. (Laughter) (Applause) So this has actually been a little bit startling
sentences.zh: 那么让我们回到那个。 （笑声）（掌声）所以这实际上有点令人吃惊

sentences.en: to the game-development community. (Laughter) Because this is about 10 dollars of additional hardware if you already have a Nintendo Wii.
sentences.zh: 到游戏开发社区。 （笑声）因为如果你已经有一台 Nintendo Wii，那么这大约是 10 美元的额外硬件。

sentences.en: So I'm looking forward to seeing some games, and actually Louis Castle, that's him down there, last week announced that Electronic Arts, one of the largest game publishers, is releasing a game in May that has a little Easter egg feature
sentences.zh: 所以我很期待看到一些游戏，实际上路易斯·卡斯尔（Louis Castle），就是他，上周宣布，最大的游戏发行商之一艺电（Electronic Arts）将于五月发布一款带有复活节彩蛋功能的游戏

sentences.en: for supporting this type of head tracking.
sentences.zh: 用于支持这种类型的头部跟踪。

sentences.en: And that's from less than five months from a prototype in my lab to a major commercial product.
sentences.zh: 从我实验室的原型到主要的商业产品，不到五个月的时间。

sentences.en: (Applause) Thank you. (Applause) But actually, to me, what's almost more interesting than either of these two projects
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）谢谢。 （掌声）但实际上，对我来说，比这两个项目中的任何一个都更有趣

sentences.en: is how people actually found out about them.
sentences.zh: 人们实际上是如何发现它们的。

sentences.en: YouTube has really changed the way, or changed the speed, in which a single individual can actually spread an idea around the world.
sentences.zh: YouTube 确实改变了个人可以在全世界传播想法的方式或速度。

sentences.en: I'm doing some research in my lab with a video camera, and within the first week, a million people had seen this work, and literally within days, engineers, teachers and students from around the world were already posting their own YouTube videos
sentences.zh: 我正在实验室用摄像机进行一些研究，在第一周内，一百万人观看了这项工作，几天之内，来自世界各地的工程师、教师和学生已经发布了他们自己的 YouTube 视频

sentences.en: of them using my system or derivatives of this work.
sentences.zh: 他们使用我的系统或这项工作的衍生品。

sentences.en: So I hope to see more of that in the future, and hope online video distribution to be embraced by the research community.
sentences.zh: 因此，我希望将来能看到更多这样的内容，并希望在线视频分发能够受到研究界的欢迎。

sentences.en: So thank you very much. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。 （掌声）
